theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_curvature_term_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (G : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (σ ρ R : ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → IntegrableOn G (closedBall ξ R) μ → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ m, 0 < ε m) → (∀ m, (1 + ε m) * ρ ≤ R) → (∀ m, Continuous (φ m)) → (∀ m s, 0 ≤ φ m s ∧ φ m s ≤ 1) → (∀ m s, s ≤ 1 → φ m s = 1) → (∀ m s, 1 + ε m ≤ s → φ m s = 0) → IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x, φ m (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) * G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)))
